description: Download an image or video from a public URL and attach it to a Postel draft. Supported: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV and WebM, up to 100 MB and within the platform's limits (X: up to 4 images, or one video or GIF; LinkedIn: up to 20 images, or one video). Scheduled and published posts cannot be changed.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an image or video

name: attach-media
title: Attach media from URL
